title: The Bride Confesses Her Love

questions.question: What is the Song of Songs, which is whose?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:1 (ESV): "The Song of Songs, which is Solomon's."

questions.question: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is better than what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:2 (ESV): "for your love is better than wine."

questions.question: I am very dark, but lovely, O daughters of whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:5 (ESV): "I am very dark, but lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem,"

questions.question: Draw me after you; let us what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:4 (ESV): "Draw me after you; let us run."

questions.question: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh that lies between my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:13 (ESV): "My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh that lies between my breasts."

questions.question: Do not gaze at me because I am dark, because the sun has done what to me?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:6 (ESV): "Do not gaze at me because I am dark, because the sun has looked upon me."

questions.question: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture your what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:7 (ESV): "Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture your flock,"

questions.question: The king has brought me into his what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:4 (ESV): "The king has brought me into his chambers."

questions.question: Your anointing oils are fragrant; your name is oil poured out; therefore do the virgins do what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:3 (ESV): "therefore the virgins love you."

questions.question: Behold, you are beautiful, my love; behold, you are beautiful; your eyes are what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:15 (ESV): "your eyes are doves."

questions.question: I compare you, my love, to a mare among whose chariots?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:9 (ESV): "I compare you, my love, to a mare among Pharaoh's chariots."

questions.question: My mother's sons were angry with me; they made me keeper of the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:6 (ESV): "they made me keeper of the vineyards,"

questions.question: If you do not know, O most beautiful among women, follow in the tracks of the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:8 (ESV): "follow in the tracks of the flock,"

questions.question: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of where?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:14 (ESV): "My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of Engedi."

questions.question: The beams of our house are cedar; our rafters are what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 1:17 (ESV): "The beams of our house are cedar; our rafters are pine."

key_verse_text: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is better than wine.
